verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS communications platform like Dialpad, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents such a control. The contact-anonymization and call-data-removal endpoints delete customer data, which is an adjacent capability rather than an opt-out of product telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
